critical_code_review_comments: OwnerNav.jsx renders both the desktop <aside data-testid=owner-sidebar> and the mobile <aside data-testid=owner-drawer> at all viewports (hidden via lg:hidden / hidden lg:flex). This produces duplicate data-testid values (nav-home, nav-cards, ...) in the DOM. Not a functional bug (CSS hides one) but breaks strict-mode Playwright selectors and can confuse assistive tech (both trees are present). Recommend gating with `useMediaQuery` or aria-hidden on the inactive one, or scope selectors: get_by_test_id('owner-sidebar').get_by_test_id('nav-home').
